name: itecs-halopsa
description: Cross-platform HaloPSA MCP connector for ITECS read workflows and guarded ticket writes.

interface.longDescription: Provides bundled HaloPSA lookup tools plus approval-gated public-note, ticket-create, and ticket-status tools. Writes are exact-target, one-shot, and require independent read-back. Credentials and runtime configuration stay outside the plugin.
defaultPrompt: List HaloPSA purchase orders that need CFO review.
Look up a HaloPSA client, invoice, contract, PO, ticket, or project.
Add an approved client-visible note to an exact HaloPSA ticket.
Create an approved HaloPSA ticket after previewing every field.
Move an exact HaloPSA ticket to an approved status after revalidation.
